subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the canonical fix carry explicit paragraph-boundary metadata through block delivery, reserve separator width in the text chunker, or intentionally land a common-case text-only repair while tracking maxChars overflow separately?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the open PR discussions show the remaining exact-boundary case changes the delivery contract or chunking semantics, which needs maintainer direction before choosing one candidate implementation.

options.title: Require full boundary semantics
options.body: Choose a fix that preserves paragraph boundaries for separate and coalesced deliveries across maxChars cases, likely via explicit seam metadata or reserved separator width.

options.title: Accept common-case text repair
options.body: Land one candidate for the common in-budget paragraph case and keep the rare maxChars overflow boundary as separately tracked follow-up work.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Reject the current text-only direction for now and ask for a fresh design that changes the boundary contract deliberately.

recommendation.title: Require full boundary semantics
recommendation.body: Choose a fix that preserves paragraph boundaries for separate and coalesced deliveries across maxChars cases, likely via explicit seam metadata or reserved separator width.

likelyOwner.reason: The coalescer and chunking history makes this the best available routing owner for the delivery-boundary semantics choice.
